description: This file defines React components for a custom context menu UI, wrapping Radix UI primitives and providing styled, reusable components for context menu functionality.

methods.name: ContextMenu
methods.description: Main context menu container component that renders Radix UI Root with additional data attribute.

methods.name: ContextMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the context menu, wrapping Radix Trigger component.

methods.name: ContextMenuGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping menu items, wrapping Radix Group component.

methods.name: ContextMenuPortal
methods.description: Component that renders the context menu in a portal, wrapping Radix Portal.

methods.name: ContextMenuSub
methods.description: Component for submenu, wrapping Radix Sub.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioGroup
methods.description: Component for radio button group within context menu.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubTrigger
methods.description: Component for submenu trigger with styling and icon.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubContent
methods.description: Component for submenu content with animation and styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuContent
methods.description: Main content container for the context menu, with portal and styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuItem
methods.description: Component for individual menu item with styling and variants.

methods.name: ContextMenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: Checkbox menu item with indicator icon.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioItem
methods.description: Radio button menu item with indicator icon.
